name: Embassy Workflow Returns 'Show Message' — Duplicate Request
goal: User attempts to initiate a UK visa invitation letter but has already initiated one for the same country.
constraints: Embassy workflow returns 'show message' at initialization.

phases.description: Agent initializes variables and calls embassy list workflow, which returns 'show message'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot says 'You already initiated a letter for the same country. Can you please try once the visa is approved/rejected.' and ends.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
